items.exampleEn: My father drives to work every day.
Let's meet at the train station.
We had a great trip to Tainan.
items.exampleZh: 我們去台南玩得很愉快。

items.exampleEn: Our hotel is near the beach.
items.exampleZh: 我們的飯店在海灘附近。

items.exampleEn: I love to travel with my friends.
items.exampleZh: 我很喜歡和朋友去旅行。

items.sentenceEn: The train arrives at the station at six.

items.audioEn: In Japan, we will stay at a hotel near the sea.
items.audioZh: 在日本，我們會住在海邊的飯店。
options: At a hotel near the station
At a hotel near the sea

items.stemEn: What time does the plane ____ in Taipei?
Let's ____ to Hualien by train this weekend.
items.stemZh: 這個週末我們搭火車去花蓮旅行吧。

items.passageEn: Mr. and Mrs. Wang love to travel. This year, they are taking a trip to Hualien. They will not fly or drive. They will take the train. The train leaves Taipei at eight and arrives at ten. Their hotel is near the sea.
items.passageZh: 王先生和王太太很愛旅行。今年他們要去花蓮玩。他們不搭飛機也不開車，而是搭火車。火車八點從台北出發，十點抵達。他們的飯店在海邊。

questions.questionZh: 王先生夫婦怎麼去花蓮？

referenceEn: What time does the train arrive?
rubricZh: 問時間可用 When 或 What time 開頭
問句的助動詞例如 does（後面 arrive 用原形）；用 will（When will the train arrive?）也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 travel 造一個句子，說說你喜歡怎麼旅行或想去哪裡旅行。
referenceEn: I like to travel by train.
I want to travel to Japan with my family.
rubricZh: 「搭⋯旅行」可用 travel by（例如 by train）
「去某地旅行」可用 travel to（例如 travel to Japan）
